Update the rollout ticket with the load rehearsal findings: 9-minute p95 invalidation-queue propagation and the 10% cohort cap constraint.
Prepare a support playbook for delayed permission changes before any SCIM-managed enterprise accounts are enabled in the rollout.
Maintain a revocation kill switch enabled for the initial rollout, allowing immediate disablement of the authorization cache if unexpected permission staleness or cache coherence issues arise.
